title: Aka Uraqin tukusiñap sarnaqir Jilïr Irpiri
intro: Mä chʼamani apnaqirit amuytʼañäni, jupajj chʼamampi ukat oraqer munañampiw churatäni. Aka jakhüwix jan uñt’at thakhinak qalltawayi, kawkhantix intix jaltki ukat kawkhantix jalsuski ukaruw puri, jan uñt’at jaqinakamp jikisisa ukat pä jan wali markanakat mä jach’a jan walt’äwimpiw uñjasi. ¿Khitis aka enigmático irpirixa?
clues: Nayajj aka Oraqen jaya cheqanakar puriñatakejj autoridada ukat medionak churat apnaqeritwa.
Inti jalant tuqir sarasaw mä chʼamaktʼat uma jalsun inti jalant uñjta.
Inti jalsu jakʼanjja, mä markampiw jikista, jupanakajj janiw juntʼütapat imantasiñ yatipkänti.
Yaqha markankirinakajj Gog ukat Magog sutimp uñtʼat jan walinak lurir pä markanaka contraw yanaptʼa mayipjjetäna.
Ukanakar jarkʼaqañatakejja, hierrompi ukat cobre fundidompiw mä barrera lurayäta.
Nayax yatiyawaytwa aka jark’awix Tatitujan khuyapayasiñapawa, ukat amtatäki uka pachakamaw qhiparani.

arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ إِنَّ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَهَلْ نَجْعَلُ لَكَ خَرْجًا عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَجْعَلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّۭا
verse: They said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, indeed Gog and Magog are [great] corrupters in the land. So may we assign for you an expenditure that you might make between us and them a barrier?" (18:94)
